messages:
claire_cs: Ran a short capture from three handoffs this afternoon. Putting raw bits here so we can hand to product & design. TL;DR: billing clarity, embedding freshness webhook, and Dedicated trial UX.

- Delta Health (Enterprise): asks for exportable invoice line items + billing tags per-route. Quote: "our finance team needs CSVs with route+usage lines to reconcile month-end".
- Echo Lending (Pilot): would love a webhook that fires when upsert/reindex completes; currently they poll and see stale results for search.
- Foxtrot (PLG scale): confused by Dedicated trial flow — they couldn't find cost estimate before opting in and backed out.

docs: drive/handshake/notes-echo.csv (shared). Can product pls triage into: small UX, infra investigate, and roadmap?

raj_pm: Thanks — this is great. Quick follow-ups: for Echo webhook, do we have a sample payload they'd want? for Delta, any sample billing export they expect?

claire_cs: Delta sent a sample CSV format in the notes. For Echo I pasted their desired webhook body below (copied):

```
POST https://hooks.echo.example.com/vector-update
{
  "route": "us-west-2",
  "status": "completed",
  "updated_vectors": 42,
  "last_updated": "2024-12-15T14:12:03Z",
  "job_id": "u-123abc"
}
```

They said: "if we had that hook we would stop polling and stop surfacing stale results to our users".

jules_eng: ok interesting. Two engineering notes: 1) webhook generator is doable but we need idempotency & retries (fanout for large customers). 2) if we're seeing stale results even after successful upsert, could be eventual consistency in the indexer. Need a short repro from Echo with timing & call sequence.

marie_design: For Foxtrot trial confusion I can draft a microcopy change + a small modal that previews estimated monthly spend before confirming Dedicated. Should be a 1-sprint small design + copy.

raj_pm: Proposed triage lanes:
- Quick UX (1 sprint): billing export CSV template + Dedicated trial preview modal copy.
- Infra investigate (sprint): webhook for upsert/reindex events + index-consistency probe.
- Roadmap (Q2): per-route billing UI & billing tagging system (requires analytics + billing infra).

claire_cs: Delta flagged potential renewal friction if finance can't reconcile charges. Marking as renewal-watch (low->med) until CSV export exists.

jules_eng: I'll try to repro Echo's staleness today. If I can reproduce I'll open a bug with logs and tag infra. ETA EOD. If not reproducible, we ask Echo for exact timestamps and request they enable debug logs.

trackerbot: /create_issue quick-win "billing-export-csv" created by claire_cs at 2024-03-01T16:05:00Z. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/812

claire_cs: created infra issue for webhook request too and attached their desired payload & sample logs. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/813

raj_pm: Perfect. Marie, can you share the modal mock by mid-week? I'll slot the quick UX into next sprint.

marie_design: Yep — will post Figma link and suggested copy tomorrow morning.

claire_cs: Also adding suggested enablement blurb for CSMs: 2-sentence script for Dedicated trial opt-in + billing preview. Will drop in confluence.

raj_pm: Thanks team. If Echo is high-risk for renewal we'll escalate; otherwise prioritise Quick UX + Investigate. Keep this thread updated with any customer replies. :v:
